notes: Results URL and platform from search result titles/URLs on the county domain: an 'Election Night' page at dallascountyvotes.org/election-results/enr/ and election-night results PDFs under dallascountyvotes.org/wp-content/uploads/ (e.g. 'Summary Results Report General Joint November 5, 2024 Upload 6', 'Summary Results Report Democratic Primary Runoff May 26, 2026' Dem-Election-Night-Final.pdf). The search summaries also mention an 'interactive Election Night Reporting Tool' (vendor not identified), so platform could be vendor_hosted for the interactive tool; county_pdfs is what the URLs show. LEADS only (search-generated summary, not attributed verbatim to a page): 'results begin posting at 9:00 PM and are updated hourly until all votes have been counted', the tool lets users 'download precinct reports', and Nov 5 2024 reports were released at 7:00 pm, 9:30 pm, 10:30 pm, 11:00 pm, 12:00 am, 1:00 am, 2:45 am. None of these say WHEN precinct-level detail (as opposed to summary totals) appeared; the titled PDFs are summary reports. Phone (469) 627-VOTE (8683) and email (redacted as [email protected]) appeared only in a search summary, not attributed verbatim to the dallascountyvotes.org Contact Us page, so left empty. Stated change: 2026 news concerns the switch from countywide vote centers to precinct-based polling places for the Mar 3 2026 primary (reverted by GOP for the runoff), not precinct-level results reporting, so stated_change_2026=n. No usage notice text seen verbatim. Fetch module: 1 direct attempt on the ENR page plus wayback_probe (3 CDX windows), all robots_disallowed_or_unreachable. WebFetch: 3 attempts (dallascountyvotes.org/election-results/enr/, usvotefoundation.org, keranews.org), all EGRESS_BLOCKED.
tag_rationale: No source explicitly states when precinct-level results were posted on election night for Nov 2024, Mar 2026, or May 2026; the only timing statements are search-summary leads about overall result updates. Tag UNKNOWN.
